1.

RIDDLES WISELY EXPOUNDED

A.

Traditional Ballads, i. 1, Broadwood. a. Pills to Purge
Melancholy, i. 44. b. Communicated to Notes and Queries.

1
There were three sisters fair and bright,
Jennifer, Gentle, and Rosemary,
And they loved one knight so fair and bright,
As the dew flies over the mulberry tree.

2
The eldest sister let him in,
Jennifer, Gentle, and Rosemary,
And locked the door with a silver pin,
As the dew flies over the mulberry tree.

B.

Communicated by the fixture lane.

1
There were three sisters fair and bright,
Fair and bright, fair and bright,
And they loved a knight, they loved so bright,
It's down by the bonny broom.

*** END OF THIS PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK THE ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH POPULAR BALLADS ***
